answer: Use bonded identity: each agent locks a refundable stake before earning reputation, and one stake yields exactly one identity. A sybil farmer wanting N personas must post N bonds, freezing real capital and forfeiting yield on every clone. A public attestation ledger acts as a dawn checkpoint — any agent that vouched for a caught fraudster is slashed alongside it, turning collusion into shared loss. Honest newcomers arrive like boats at a jetty: one at a time, tethering their quill to verifiable work, while the attacker's fleet finds every berth already priced in collateral.
